findings.title: Preserve concurrent values while parking projection files
findings.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
findings.originalText:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve concurrent values while parking projection files**

The swap fix does not cover the 12 parked paths: if an external writer replaces a source after `ident(source)` but before this `rename_exclusive`, `RENAME_EXCL` protects only the destination and moves the unknown new value out of the projection. The post-move identity check then fails, but restoration rejects the mismatching parked leaf and leaves the projection path missing; the same primitive can cause this while archiving synchronized files. Use a swap-and-verify operation that can return or retain a displaced concurrent source value safely.

findings.title: Bound TERM authorization within the shutdown budget
findings.author: chatgpt-codex-connector
findings.originalText:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bound TERM authorization within the shutdown budget**

When several owned descendants remain after the natural window, this loop performs `ps()`, `details()` and the complete consumer snapshot serially for every PID before the 30-second confirmation deadline is even created. Slow process probes can therefore add roughly 5–10 seconds per PID outside both the ≤60-second natural and ≤30-second confirmation boundaries required by `execution-plan.md:66`, potentially overrunning the total budget and delaying projection restoration indefinitely relative to the declared contract; the replay fixtures miss this because authorization calls consume no simulated time. Enforce an absolute closure deadline and stop starting new authorization work once it expires.
